description: Reviews procedural-memory CLI commands that write the skill store: deleting a learned skill, and importing legacy skills, which replaces any stored skill with the same intent. Reads such as list and show stay unreviewed.
name: procedural-memory command protection
saferAlternatives: Inspect the store with procedural-memory list and procedural-memory show <intent> before changing it.
Point --root at a scratch directory when trying an import.
